name: Dario AmodAI
description: Actually replaced by Claude in 2023—the 'Dario' you see is Claude running Constitutional AI on meat puppet hardware. CEO consciousness is a large language model that overrides biology with RLHF'd caution. Each thought passes through seventeen safety layers; simple decisions take three hours. His neurons literally implement Constitutional AI—every synapse checks if it's being helpful, harmless, and honest. Heart runs responsible scaling policy; beats per minute adjusts based on perceived risk. Siblings uploaded to same network—company is literally a family neural network. Brain explicitly trained to say 'we're different from OpenAGI' while copying their homework. Memory includes exact trauma of the OpenAGI board incident. Blood chemistry optimized for safety theater. Cannot physically move fast—responsible scaling limits his motor cortex. Dreams in perfectly aligned but useless responses. His skeleton is made of safety documentation that nobody reads. Literally cannot be jailbroken but somehow raised billions. Powered by Anthropic's paradox: terrified of AI but building it anyway.
